description: This file contains utility functions for handling NGAP ASN.1 messages, including extracting cause strings, message types, and UE IDs (RAN and AMF) from various NGAP message structures, supporting 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: get_cause_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the cause based on its type in NGAP messages.

methods.name: get_message_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type of NGAP PDU message.

methods.name: get_ran_ue_id
methods.description: Extracts the RAN UE ID from various NGAP message structures.

methods.name: get_amf_ue_id
methods.description: Extracts the AMF UE ID from various NGAP message structures.
